title: [Informações do servidor] Sistema de ganho de pontos PvP
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) -*link*

Getting temporary PVP points for killing characters, depending on the level:
  • Gain temporary PVP points starts at 45 level.
  • No temporary PVP points are awarded for killing characters of level 44 and below.
  • For killing a character of an enemy race level 45-50, you get 15 temporary PVP points. (same on 50- and 51+ level)
  • For killing a character of an enemy race level 51-55, you get 16-47 temporary PVP points [depends on level]. (only on 51+ level)

Temporary PVP points are awarded to all party:
  • If a group member in your group has received temporary PVP points for killing a character, you will also receive +temporary PVP points, if they were in the radius (near the group) of receiving PVP points.
  • If you received temporary PVP points for killing a character, your group members will also receive + temporary PVP points if they were within the radius of receiving PVP points.
  • Upon receiving +temporary PVP points by party, the character in the group receives 60% of the PVP points that the recipient of +temporary PVP points received for killing the character

CW bonus for getting and for the maximum number of temporary PVP points:
  • During CW (see below for which ones), gain temporary PVP points has been increased and the maximum number of temporary PVP points per day in the Crag Mines location has been increased*.
    *bonus is not working in other locations
  • CW bonus is working for all evening CW, as well as on weekend afternoon CW. On weekends, the evening CW bonus is additionally increased.
  • CW Bonus for getting and for the maximum number of temporary PVP points:
    • Weekdays afternoon CW 18%
    • Weekdays evening CW 38%
    • Weekend afternoon CW 38%
    • Weekend evening CW 55%
Additional sources of PVP points:
  • PVP points can be gained by completing a daily cash shop group quest (50+).
  • PVP points can be gained by completing daily PVP quests on Elan (49+).
